item.title: Vikings fire general manager Kwesi Adofo-Mensah
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS (AP) — The Minnesota Vikings have fired general manager Kwesi Adofo-Mensah after mixed results over four seasons and giving him a contract extension last year. item.title: Essentia Health announces new family medicine clinic in heart of downtown Moorhead
item.description: MOORHEAD, Minn. (KVRR) — Essentia Health is expanding its care with a new family medicine clinic in the heart of downtown Moorhead. The new clinic will open at the former Wells Fargo building at 730 Center Ave. The 8,100-square-foot clinic will include a procedural room, laboratory, and radiology services, as well as primary care services.
